analysis.reasonEn: RSI holds at 53.3 in neutral territory, and MACD histogram shows improvement but remains negative. The 5-day return was -0.80%, closing lower, but the weekly ADX at 27.8 suggests an ongoing clear trend. The current price ($493.78) is below the SMA20 ($497.51) and near the swing support ($493.25), warranting a wait-and-see approach.
